hypotheses.title: Skip CTNL reversals when growth and inflation both accelerate
hypotheses.thesis: Gold reversal setups fail when growth and inflation accelerate together because gold trends persist in reflation phases.
hypotheses.mechanism: Reflation drives persistent real-asset demand; failed-continuation signals are overrun by trend flow, so reversal stops get hit.
evidence_basis: IS avg R 0.02 (30 trades) vs 1.07-1.56 when inflation slows
memory: regime filter is the only lever for CTNL

proposed_rule_changes.change: skip entry when macro regime joint == g↑·accel × π↑·accel

kill_criteria: Forward 2026-11..2027-03: filtered ΣR not better than unfiltered
Deflated Sharpe over all trials of the lock < 0.5 on IS

minimum_viable_experiment.goal: IS comparison filtered vs unfiltered, counted as one trial
minimum_viable_experiment.setup: IS only via research_lock, OOS skipped, then forward

hypotheses.rationale: Plausible mechanism, consistent with known regime lever.
assumptions: TTP simulation represents live fills closely enough
dependencies: daily index/gold closes, VIX, macro regime labels

hypotheses.title: Avoid Friday entries (weekend hold)
hypotheses.thesis: Reversal entries on Friday carry weekend gap risk inside a 96h hold.
hypotheses.mechanism: Weekend gaps jump past the 3-ATR stop and remove the time the reversal needs; Monday reopen often resumes the trend.
evidence_basis: IS Friday avg R 0.01 (18 trades) vs 0.56-1.29

proposed_rule_changes.change: no new CTNL entries on Friday

hypotheses.title: Trade CTNL only in high-VIX tercile
hypotheses.thesis: Reversals work better when cross-asset fear is high.
hypotheses.mechanism: High VIX means forced deleveraging, gold sold for liquidity then reverses.

proposed_rule_changes.change: only enter when VIX prev close in IS top tercile
